messages:
maria: quick check — I ran the non-chat reranker workload with the new prefill threshold and saw odd KV eviction churn during bursts. attaching profiling snippets below.

jonathan: can you paste the profiler output? curious if it's kernel-bound or memory-bandwidth.

maria: p95 latency improved ~8% overall, but during 10k qps spikes we see KV cache eviction rate jump and hot-shard thrash. sample: 
```
kernel: aten_fast_gemm_fused
seq_len: 64
kv_hits: 0.72
evictions/s: 430
cpu_wait: 12ms
gpu_util: 78%
```

kevin: that kernel is the small-seq optimized GEMM. eviction/s that high suggests our prefill window allows too many unique prefixes into KV for rerank batches. what prefill budget did you use?

maria: token_budget_target=1200 (per-slot), prefill_threshold=0.35, slot_window=50ms.

lia: two quick thoughts: (1) lower prefill threshold for non-chat endpoints — they have much higher churn, (2) try group-by-doc hashing so related queries reuse same slot affinity.

jonathan: agree on lower prefill. Also we should prefer the bulk-gemm kernel for batches > 96 tokens; kernel selector might be misfiring because batched sequence distribution has long tail. I have a quick patch that biases kernel selection by 10% towards bulk when batch_size>48.

kevin: can we simulate that bias in the queue-sim? I want to see cost/latency delta before flipping runtime.

maria: ran a sim with bias=0.1, results: p95 -3.5%, cost per token +0.6%, prefetch evictions down 60% during spikes. full sim output: 
```
scenario: bias_bulk_0.1
avg_latency: 28ms
p95_latency: 52ms
cost_per_tok: 0.0032
eviction_rate: 170/s
```

jonathan: nice. sounds like small uptick in compute cost but big win on KV stability. that matters for tail latency. we should also adjust the queue policy to prefer slot consolidation: when slots contain >50% same-doc hits, let them fill to token_budget_target before flushing.

lia: implementable as a cheap heuristic: on slot close, if doc_affinity_score >= 0.5 and remaining_budget < 0.2*token_budget_target then extend wait by 20ms once. low-risk.

kevin: worth A/Bing on staging. can we add a perf regression guard in the rollout with metrics: p95_latency, eviction_rate, cost_per_tok, kernel_switch_rate?

maria: added to canary config: 
```
rollout_gates:
  - p95_latency: < +5% (stable)
  - eviction_rate: < -20% (improvement expected)
  - kernel_switch_rate: < +15% (avoid churn)
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for runtime-canary/kv-prefill-econ@[canary-5] by jonathan

ops-bot: smoke tests passed. tracing enabled for rerank endpoints. will ping if tail > 200ms.

jonathan: next steps: (1) run canary (2) collect kernel switch breakdown & KV hotset heatmap (3) if good, roll bias from 0.1 -> 0.25 over 24h.

maria: logging the profiling artifacts and sim configs to /infra/perf/artifacts/2165001234 for postmortem. thanks folks, will update after 2h canary run. :thumbsup:
